name: v0.22.0
body:
## What's Changed
* Add fx installed agent integration by @fazxes in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2683
* Classify service unavailable API errors by @mgeorgaklis in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2604
* Fix GKE resource name sanitization by @mgeorgaklis in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2678
* Skip empty metrics in job progress by @mgeorgaklis in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2681
* fix(antigravity): preserve legacy SSE MCP support by @mgeorgaklis in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2642
* Hosted custom agents by @scvance in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2329
* Add vercel prefix. by @alexgshaw in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2699
* fix(docker): probe the daemon kernel for egress control regardless of client platform by @xichen1997 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2580
* Add Hyperbrowser sandbox environment by @Dingway98 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2447
* Improve trial upload database handling by @alexgshaw in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2711
* fix: honor configured base URL for opencode's google provider by @psbang in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2627
* feat(cli): target one of several --plugin values with PLUGIN.key=value kwargs by @shalupov in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2716
* fix(Devin): Support ATIF trajectories by @sam571128 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2713
* Support including retry history in Hub trial and job downloads by @alexgshaw in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2721
* Record grok-build token usage and cost by @RyanMarten in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2722
* feat(langgraph): support LangGraphJS by @nick-hollon-lc in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2746
* fix(modal): forward the region environment kwarg to sandboxes by @scvance in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2751
* feat(mini-swe-agent): add model_registry kwarg for LiteLLM model regi… by @scvance in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2442
* [harbor-langsmith] use X-Tenant-Id for workspace routing by @casparb in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2749
* [harbor-langsmith] propagate workspace to nested agent traces by @casparb in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2750
* docs: point LangSmith links to the Harbor integrations page by @nick-hollon-lc in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2752
* Classify Anthropic prompt overflow as context error by @mgeorgaklis in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2747
* Add MCode installed agent integration by @hetaoBackend in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2755
* Fix broken documentation links and redirects by @alexgshaw in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2762
* feat(environments/vercel-sandbox) Add Vercel Sandbox Environment by @kajogo777 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2748
* Let the cortex-code agent restrict tools by @daniel-huang-1230 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2787
* feat(opencode): support Alpine/musl images by @dain5832 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2743
* feat(mini-swe-agent): support Alpine/musl images and Python 3.9 task images by @dain5832 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2742
* fix(openhands-sdk): request coreutils so stdbuf exists at run time by @dain5832 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2740
* Fix MCode custom provider model limits by @hetaoBackend in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2772
* feat(pi): support explicit custom endpoints by @osolmaz in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2647
* Add CLI commands to share, unshare, and inspect task/dataset access by @alexgshaw in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2765
* Integrate Junie Agent with Harbor by @mashan555 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2613
* Add code mode support to the cortex-code agent by @daniel-huang-1230 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2774
* [Ready for Review] Adapter: programbench by @bencalvert04 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2295
* fix(cwsandbox): log runner/node resource diagnostics on sandbox error by @anson627 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2601
* fix(cwsandbox): default max_lifetime_seconds to 1 hour by @anson627 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2602
* Add MCode skills directory support by @TrentChou in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2769
* Add inline extra instructions via config and CLI by @alexgshaw in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2293
* feat(antigravity): agy 1.1.x support — headless API-key/ADC auth, workspace-anchored runs, ATIF trajectories by @dot-agi in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2776
* Org-first ownership in the Harbor CLI by @scvance in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2810
* fix(rewardkit): raise on duplicate criterion names to prevent slug collisions by @dumko2001 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2331
* Simplify RewardKit agent judges by @benediktstroebl in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2820
* Add simulated-user multi-turn trials over ACP (RFC 0002) by @jkunstle in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2405
* Support nested RewardKit dimension groups by @benediktstroebl in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2821
* chore: remove the hello-simulated-user example task by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2822
* docs: add simulated user page by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2823
* feat: record simulated-user shape in job telemetry by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2824
* Launch and lifecycle CLI by @scvance in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2357
* Let tasks ship prior context as trajectory.json beside instruction.md by @miguelrc-scale in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2529
* RFC: simulated users with ACP (comments welcomed!) by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/1878
* feat(viewer): add simulated-user interaction view by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2825
* test: fix CI by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2826
* feat(environments/cwsandbox): support cwsandbox SDK 1.x network dialect by @matthoare117-wandb in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2786
* feat: add task-level ATIF trajectory example task and docs by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2632
* docs: scaffold Mintlify navigation by @kobe0938 in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2827

## New Contributors
* @fazxes made their first contribution in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2683
* @xichen1997 made their first contribution in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2580
* @Dingway98 made their first contribution in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2447
* @shalupov made their first contribution in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2716
* @casparb made their first contribution in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2749
* @kajogo777 made their first contribution in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2748
* @daniel-huang-1230 made their first contribution in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2787
* @dain5832 made their first contribution in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2743
* @osolmaz made their first contribution in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2647
* @mashan555 made their first contribution in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2613
* @anson627 made their first contribution in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2601
* @TrentChou made their first contribution in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2769
* @dumko2001 made their first contribution in https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/pull/2331

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/harbor-framework/harbor/compare/v0.21.0...v0.22.0
